name: Himadri
headline: Stories by Himadri
tagline: Wedding and portrait photography from Cooch Behar and Delhi. Honest light, real moments.

about.title: I’m Himadri, and I tell stories with a camera.
text: I grew up in Cooch Behar and now live in Delhi. I’m the photographer, owner and editor of Himadri Photography, and I shoot weddings, couples, portraits and events in both cities, and wherever your story takes us.

A wedding is a few days of big emotions, with a lot happening at once. My job is to be calm in the middle of it, notice the small things and keep you comfortable. You’ll get photos of the laughter, the rituals and the quiet moments, not only posed pictures.
I edit every photo myself, so the colours and mood stay consistent from the first ritual to the last dance. Send me your date on WhatsApp and we’ll talk through what you have in mind.

facts.l: Delhi and Cooch Behar, travel on request
shoots and edits every story himself
haldi to reception, covered start to finish

faq.q: How do I book a date?
faq.a: Pick an open date in the calendar, choose a time and send the request on WhatsApp. Himadri will reply to confirm.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: As early as you can, especially for wedding season. Open dates in the calendar are updated regularly.

faq.q: Do you shoot outside Delhi and Cooch Behar?
faq.a: Yes. Message the city and dates, and Himadri will share a quote that includes travel.

faq.q: Do you cover all wedding functions?
faq.a: Yes. Haldi, mehendi, sangeet, the wedding and the reception can be covered together or one by one.

faq.q: Do you shoot candid and traditional photos?
faq.a: Both. You get the family and ritual photos you expect, plus candid moments of the day.

faq.q: How many photos will I receive, and when?
faq.a: It depends on the shoot. Ask for the delivery time and the number of edited photos when you book.
Yes. Albums and prints are available. Ask for options when you book.

faq.q: Can we plan a pre-wedding shoot at a special location?
faq.a: Yes. Share the place you have in mind, or ask for suggestions in Delhi or Cooch Behar.
Himadri will share the details on WhatsApp once the date and package are agreed.
Message as soon as you know, and Himadri will check for another open date.
